Name: Chest QuickLoad
Author: secsky3
Description:
[center]
[size=6][b]Chest QuickLoad[/b][/size]
[size=4][i]One-Click Safe Chest Transfer (Dump & Retrieve All) with Auto Hotbar Sorting[/i][/size]

[url=https://ko-fi.com/secsky3][img]https://ko-fi.com/img/githubbutton_sm.svg[/img][/url]
[/center]

[line]

[size=5][b]✨ Overview[/b][/size]
Tired of manually clicking every single item just to empty your pockets or stash dungeon loot?
[b]Chest QuickLoad[/b] adds intuitive, vanilla-style [b]Load All (Deposit)[/b] and [b]Unload All (Retrieve)[/b] buttons to your chest menus.

Dump all your loot with a single click—[b]without worrying about accidentally stashing your best weapon and pickaxe![/b]

[line]

[size=5][b]🌟 Key Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]📦 Load to Chest (▲ Dump All)[/b]: Transports all your inventory items into the chest in one click.[/*]
[*][b]🛡️ Smart Tool Protection[/b]: [b]Never accidentally stash your essential tools![/b] Your strongest weapon and highest-tier pickaxe are automatically preserved in your bag during transfers.[/*]
[*][b]📥 Unload from Chest (▼ Retrieve All)[/b]: Pulls everything from the chest into your inventory at once, instantly cleaning up empty chest slots.[/*]
[*][b]🗡️ Auto Hotbar Sorting[/b]: Keeps your best melee weapon in Slot 1 and your best pickaxe in Slot 2 whenever inventory changes or when entering mines and dungeons.[/*]
[*][b]🎨 Seamless Vanilla Design[/b]: Perfectly matches the base game UI with authentic wooden frames, button hover effects, audio feedback, and multilingual tooltips.[/*]
[*][b]🛡️ 100% Conflict-Free[/b]: Built strictly with standard SMAPI events (Zero Harmony patches). Safe to install/uninstall anytime and fully compatible with ChestsAnywhere and UI mods.[/*]
[*][b]⚙️ GMCM Configurable[/b]: Easily toggle transfer buttons, auto-sorting behaviors, and auto-weapon selection in the in-game settings.[/*]
[/list][line]

[size=5][b]🎮 How It Works[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][b]Load All into Chest (▲)[/b]: Open any chest and click the top transfer button. All items move to the chest, while your best weapon and pickaxe stay securely in your hands. Overflow items safely remain in your backpack.[/*]
[*][b]Unload All to Inventory (▼)[/b]: Click the bottom transfer button to grab everything from the chest. Your tools are automatically rearranged back to Slots 1 and 2 right after.[/*]
[*][b]Dungeon Entry[/b]: Entering the Mines or Volcano Dungeon automatically aligns your best combat gear and actively selects Slot 1.[/*]
[/list][line]

[size=5][b]📥 Requirements & Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] (v4.0.0 or higher, Stardew Valley 1.6+).[/*]
[*](Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url] for in-game configuration.[/*]
[*]Download this mod and extract the [b]ChestQuickLoad[/b] folder into your [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b] directory.[/*]
[*]Launch the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][line]

[size=5][b]🇰🇷 한국어 안내[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]개요[/b]: 보관함(상자) 메뉴에서 원클릭으로 가방의 아이템을 전부 넣거나(업로드) 상자 아이템을 전부 꺼낼 수 있는(언로드) 편의성 모드입니다.[/*]
[*][b]상자로 모두 넣기 (▲)[/b]: 가방 안의 아이템을 상자로 한 번에 털어 넣습니다. [b]가장 좋은 무기와 곡괭이는 자동으로 인식되어 상자에 들어가지 않고 가방에 안전하게 남습니다.[/b][/*]
[*][b]상자에서 모두 받기 (▼)[/b]: 상자 안의 물품을 가방으로 일괄 회수하며, 회수 직후 무기와 곡괭이를 1, 2번 슬롯으로 다시 자동 정렬합니다.[/*]
[*][b]핫바 자동 정렬[/b]: 아이템 입출고 시 및 광산/화산 진입 시 최고 무기(1번 슬롯)와 최고 곡괭이(2번 슬롯)를 항상 최우선 배치합니다.[/*]
[*][b]안전성[/b]: 하모니(Harmony) 패치를 일절 쓰지 않는 순수 SMAPI 표준 구현으로 다른 보관함 모드와의 충돌이나 세이브 훼손 위험이 전혀 없습니다.[/*]
[/list]
